w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Spool is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE TERMS OF SERVICE! You're on your own.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Ugly-Eyes." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
Ants march past your boot, laden. You follow them to a seep. +1L water (risky). (ant_trail)
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.

noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,266 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
